name: ONBOARDING_FLOW
description: Onboarding checklists per role and location with owners, due dates relative to the join date, dependencies, reminders (drafted, not sent), completion percentage and blocked-state reporting. Collects PAN, bank account, Aadhaar (last four plus keyed hash only), documents and tax/PF/ESI forms as data capture: identifiers AES-GCM sealed at rest and masked unless authorize_read allows.
